Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.report

Class JsonMetadata

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.report.JsonMetadata
public class JsonMetadata extends Object
The shape of the metadata block in the JSON file. Gson turns it into JSON, using these field names as the keys.
